kitchen.prompt: The view through a kitchen window onto an empty cobbled village street on a summer evening under a blue sky: the houses opposite with red tiled roofs, cream plaster and wooden doors, a big tree on the left, cobblestones in the sunlight.

title.prompt: An empty country road winding down between vineyards in the warm sunset light, grass and wildflowers at the roadside, long shadows.

pitch-enztal.prompt: An empty gravel camper pitch by the river Enz on a warm evening: gravel, tufts of grass and wildflowers, the glittering river and a wooden fence behind, the low sun on the left.

pitch-muehlacker.prompt: An empty gravel camper pitch on an orchard meadow on a warm evening: gravel, grass, wildflowers, the trunks of old apple trees behind.

pitch-schwarzwald.prompt: An empty gravel camper pitch at the foot of a steep slope with dark fir trees in a Black Forest valley in the evening: gravel, grass, mossy stones, ferns.

pitch-stuttgart.prompt: An empty quiet paved parking place at the edge of the hills above Stuttgart at night: a low wall, grass at its edge, the lit city roofs in the valley behind.

homecoming.prompt: An empty cobbled driveway in front of a garage and a half-timbered house at night, a low hedge and garden flowers at the left edge, warm light on the cobbles.
